definitions.explanation: Describes something having a square or rectangular shape with four corners.
Describes a personality or manner that is rigid, formal, or inflexible.

examples.japanese: {四角|しかく}い⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put it in the square box.

examples.japanese: {四角|しかく}い⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a rectangular table in the middle of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんなに→そんなに：01646_sonnani⟧{四角|しかく}い⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Don't think in such a rigid way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四角|しかく}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じない→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧。
examples.english: He has a rigid personality and doesn't get jokes.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{四角|しかく}→四角：02836_shikaku⟧く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した{方|ほう}がいいよ→方がいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should speak in a less stiff way.

notes:
{四角|しかく}い is the everyday adjective for describing square or rectangular shapes. It covers both squares and rectangles — any shape with four corners.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {四角|しかく}い⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧: square/rectangular box
- {四角|しかく}い⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: square/angular face
- {四角|しかく}い⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧: rectangular table
- ⟦{四角|しかく}→四角：02836_shikaku⟧く⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut into a square shape

USAGE:
Describes a rigid, overly formal personality: {四角|しかく}い⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧ (rigid thinking). The four-character compound ⟦{四角四面|しかくしめん}→四角四面：noentry⟧ means "extremely stiff and formal."

RELATED SHAPE ADJECTIVES:
- ⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧: round
- ⟦{細長|ほそなが}い→細長い：06670_hosonagai⟧: long and thin
- ⟦{平|たい}ら→平ら：03399_taira⟧: flat
